name: Hobgoblin Devastator

traits.name: Martial Advantage
traits.description: Once per turn, the hobgoblin can deal an extra 10 (3d6) damage to a creature it hits with an attack if that creature is within 5 ft. of an ally of the hobgoblin that isn't incapacitated.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.description: The hobgoblin is a 6th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following wizard spells prepared: Cantrips (at will): fire bolt, light, mage hand, prestidigitation. 1st level (4 slots): mage armor, magic missile, shield. 2nd level (3 slots): misty step, scorching ray. 3rd level (3 slots): fireball, fly.

actions.name: Redirect Attack
actions.description: When a creature the hobgoblin can see targets it with an attack, the hobgoblin chooses another hobgoblin within 5 ft. of it. The two hobgoblins swap places, and the chosen hobgoblin becomes the target instead of the original hobgoblin.

actions.name: Quarterstaff
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit (+4 to hit with shield spell), reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage, or 4 (1d8) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.

description: Hobgoblin devastators are battle-mages who study arcane magic to serve their legions, hurling destructive spells from the back ranks while lesser hobgoblins shield them from harm.
